decisions.reason: As a renamed version of an already well-liked trommel screen, this product combines prior market acceptance with years of accumulated commitment, making management very unlikely to withdraw it in the next year.

This multi-model mobile shredder line reflects substantial development and public commitment on a dedicated page, and in a long-cycle German machinery business management would tend to continue backing it rather than reverse course.

Even with less visible promotion, the multi-model mobile grinder line fits the firm's mobile processing strategy and carries enough sunk development effort that management would likely keep it and treat any weakness as temporary or model-specific.

This stationary electric fine shredder is the least visibly committed of the group, but it still aligns with tougher and more resource-saving processing solutions, so escalation of commitment still points more toward retention than withdrawal.

The green-waste grinder line is a specialized but coherent extension of the firm's mobile portfolio, and management would be inclined to preserve that investment and market presence rather than abandon it after several years.

The stationary single-shaft pre-shredder line shows strong investment and clear public commitment through several models and dedicated presentation, which makes management reluctant to take it off the market within the coming year.
